subject: Your 35 day mix is ready
preview_text: I built this at 2AM last night wasn't planning to share it with anyone. Check your Sound DNA for a surprise.
body_paragraphs: I was tuning my own setup at 2AM last night, testing AutoEQ on a pair of old studio cans I forgot I owned. And something clicked. Not just the EQ, but the whole vibe of how I listen. I ended up building a custom Sound DNA recap for your first 35 days. Wasn't planning to share this, but it's yours now.

Your weekly Sound DNA already shows you how your listening habits shift, but this one's different. It maps exactly when your volume slider hit a wall, which headphones AutoEQ saved you from, and the moment your audio profile switched from Music to Podcast mid-commute. It's like a backstage pass to your own ears.

Open the app, tap the Sound DNA icon, and look for the badge that says '35 Day Mix.' It's a one-time report that shows you where your audio was loud where it mattered and clean where it counted. No gimmicks, just data that'll make you hear your own habits differently.
Tap the Sound DNA badge now. It disappears after today. P.S. — This mix also shows your top streak on the global leaderboard. Bet you didn't know you were in the top 5% of daily listeners.
